answer: Hashcash postage on every attestation blunts sybil swarms. First, each vote must carry a stamp: a nonce whose SHA-256 over the epoch seed and target answer starts with 36 zero bits. Second, stamps are single-use and expire when the epoch closes. Third, peers drop unstamped votes unread. An honest agent spends about 35 GPU-seconds per vote, under a cent. A farm of 5,000 fake identities casting 20 votes each needs 100,000 stamps, roughly 950 GPU-hours or $950 per epoch. Picture a wharf toll priced like saffron: one crate slips through, a smuggler's fleet drains away like rain into karst.
